get.description: Health check that verifies database connectivity.

Search for games by name via IGDB.

Results already in gamedb include `game_id` plus cached OpenCritic and HLTB
data. Search never triggers OpenCritic/HLTB fetches (rate limits); import a
result with GET /api/games/by-igdb/{igdb_id} to get the full record.

post.description:
Cached GameDB summaries (game id, IGDB id, OpenCritic, HLTB) for Steam apps already linked to a game.

Read-only: never calls IGDB, OpenCritic or HLTB, so it is safe for whole libraries.
Apps not linked yet are simply absent from the response.

Import a Steam library into GameDB through IGDB and group it into works.

IGDB only (batched, a few calls per few hundred apps); never calls OpenCritic,
HLTB or Steam. Returns the work id for every app that matched.

Return cached type/categories/tags for Steam apps and queue unknown ones.

Metadata is fetched by a throttled background worker, so newly queued apps
come back with ``ready: false`` until it reaches them.
Map Steam apps to their works (read-only; no external calls). Unknown apps are absent.
